# Riddle

> Riddle is a SaaS platform for creating interactive content — quizzes, surveys, personality tests, polls, prediction games, forms, minigames, leaderboards, flashcards, and stories. Content is built in a no-code visual editor (with AI assistance) and embedded via iframe or JS snippet into any website, CMS, or app. Riddle is not a CMS, website builder, or email tool — it creates interactive content that plugs into your existing stack (CMS, CRM, DMP, analytics, ad servers). 100% GDPR-compliant, ISO 27001 certified, WCAG 2.1 accessible. Used by BBC, Red Bull, Tate Modern, Amazon/Goodreads, Stage Entertainment. Plans from €119-749/month, 14-day free trial.

## Overview

- Company: Riddle Technologies AG, Lenaustr. 1, 66125 Saarbrucken, Germany
- Founded: 2014 by Boris Pfeiffer — one of the longest-operating interactive content platforms on the market, trusted in production by major media and enterprise clients for over a decade
- Products: Riddle (enterprise platform), Qzzr (SMB, qzzr.com), Convert by Riddle (seasonal campaign platform — prediction games, advent calendars, acquired from Contentbird)
- Notable clients: BBC, Red Bull, Shopify, Stage Entertainment, Tate Modern, Amazon/Goodreads, Den of Geek, Fiesta Bowl, Which?, 20 Minuten, Club Med
- Compliance: 100% GDPR-compliant (EU-only data hosting, no tracking by default), ISO 27001 certified (TUV, since March 2025), WCAG 2.1 accessible (keyboard nav, screen readers, semantic markup)
- Data hosting: Company-owned servers in Germany and Luxembourg (banking-grade data centers, not cloud)
- Free trial: 14 days, all features unlocked, no credit card required. No free plan — paid subscription required after trial. When trial ends (or subscription is cancelled), content is temporarily unpublished but not deleted; re-subscribing re-publishes everything.
- Languages: Platform interface in 67 languages. Content can be created in any language, including RTL (Arabic, Hebrew, etc.).
- Support: Live chat during European business hours, 2.1 minutes average response time
- Scale: Processes 2+ billion questions annually
- Contact: hello@riddle.com, +49 6897-9392500

## Content Types

Riddle has 8 top-level content formats (Quiz, Personality Quiz, Poll/Survey, Predictor, Form, Minigame, Leaderboard, Story). Within these formats, there are 30+ individual block types (interaction prompts, form fields, content blocks, monetization blocks) that can be combined freely. Each format has its own prompt blocks, plus shared blocks available across all types.

**How you build a Riddle:** No-code drag-and-drop visual editor. Add blocks, configure scoring/logic, style with palettes or CSS, publish. AI can generate complete content from a topic or URL in under a minute. No developer needed. Average creation time: minutes, not hours.

**Media support:** Add images, GIFs, and videos to questions, answer choices, and result pages. Built-in media libraries: Pexels (stock photos), Google Images, Giphy (GIFs), YouTube, Vimeo, X/Twitter embeds. Upload your own images or MP4 videos (video upload on Business+).

### Quiz
- [Quiz Maker](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz): Create scored knowledge quizzes with right/wrong answers.
- Prompt blocks: Single-select, multi-select, tap & find, order it, type the answer, spot the difference, flashcard, TypeRush (typing speed), guess it
- Block maker pages: [Standard Question Types](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/standard-question-types), [Tap and Find](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/tap-and-find-maker), [Order It](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/order-it-maker), [Spot the Difference](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/spot-the-difference-maker), [Flashcards](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/flashcards-maker), [TypeRush](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/typerush-maker), [Guess It](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-quiz/guess-it-maker)
- Question Bank: Maintain a pool of questions, serve randomized subsets per session — ideal for evergreen content, daily challenges, and repeat play.
- Timer, branching logic, and AI generation available.

### Personality Quiz
- [Personality Quiz Maker](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-personality-quiz): Map answers to personality outcomes using weighted scoring across multiple dimensions.
- Prompt blocks: Single-select, multi-select, tap & find, order it, type the answer, spot the difference, flashcard, TypeRush, guess it (same as Quiz — see Quiz block maker pages above)
- Scoring: Assign weighted values per answer to multiple personality dimensions. Supports Big 5/OCEAN framework, low/medium/high results, and custom CTAs per outcome.
- Use cases: Product recommendations (map answers to products), self-assessment tools, lead qualification, audience segmentation. Visitors who take personality tests stay 41% longer on average.

### Poll & Survey
- [Poll & Survey Maker](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey): Collect opinions and feedback with real-time or post-completion results.
- Prompt blocks: Single-select, multi-select, reaction poll, upvote, order it, swiper, Likert/matrix, promoter score (NPS), rate it, tier list, this or that
- Block maker pages: [Reaction Poll](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/reaction-poll-maker), [Upvote](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/upvote-maker), [Order It](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/order-it-maker), [Swiper](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/swiper-maker), [Likert Scale / Matrix](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/likert-scale-maker), [Promoter Score (NPS)](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/promoter-score-maker), [Rate It](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/rate-it-maker), [Tier List](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/tier-list-maker), [This or That](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-survey/this-or-that-poll-maker)
- Question Bank available for randomized polling at scale.

### Predictor
- [Predictor / Prediction Game](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-predictor): Users predict outcomes (sports scores, award winners, election results).
- Prompt blocks: Guess the score, pick the winner
- Connects to leaderboards for season-long competitions. Scores calculated automatically after events resolve.

### Form
- [Form Builder](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-form): Standalone or embedded within any content type. Use as contact forms, newsletter signups, competition entries, or lead gates before quiz results. 30-50% form completion rates reported.
- Form fields: Name, email, phone, URL, country picker, data & tracking consent, short text, long text, number, date picker, time picker, dropdown, radio button, checkbox, rating
- [Personal Details & Form Fields](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-form/personal-details-and-form-fields): Built-in lead-capture fields (name, email, phone, consent, and more) for collecting zero-party data inside any Riddle.
- Branching logic supported.

### Minigame
- [Minigame Maker](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame): Gamified content that connects to leaderboards for daily/weekly challenges.
- Game types: Slot machine, wheel of fortune, sudoku, crossword, minesweeper
- Game maker pages: [Slot Machine](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame/slot-machine-maker), [Wheel of Fortune](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame/wheel-of-fortune), [Sudoku](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame/sudoku-maker), [Crossword Puzzle](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame/crossword-puzzle-maker), [Minesweeper](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-minigame/minesweeper-maker)

### Leaderboard
- [Leaderboard](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-leaderboard): Display rankings across individual quizzes or cumulative scores from multiple quizzes/predictors over time. Embed standalone or show on result pages. Tracks scores, ranks, and player progress.

### Story
- Interactive narratives for listicles, guided journeys, and multimedia storytelling.
- Story prompts: Text/media, quote. Forms and monetization blocks available. No interactive prompt blocks — content is author-driven, not user-response-driven.
- Block maker pages: [Text and Media Block](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-story/text-media-block), [Quote Block](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-story/quote-block), [Interactive Graphic](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-story/interactive-graphic-maker), [Ad / iFrame Block](https://www.riddle.com/interactive-content/make-a-story/ad-iframe-block)

### Shared blocks (available in all content types)
- Forms: Make a form, insert form (embed existing forms)
- Personal details: Name, email, phone, URL, country picker, data & tracking consent
- Text input: Short text, long text, number
- Time: Date picker, time picker
- Content: Text/media block, quote block
- Form fields: Dropdown, radio button, checkbox, rating
- Monetization: Insert ad / iFrame

## Technical Capabilities

### Embedding & Publishing
- Embed methods: iframe embed code, JavaScript snippet, WordPress plugin, Wix integration, TYPO3 integration, Vue.js component, Web Component, modal popup, iOS/macOS native (WKWebView), Flutter (Android/iOS). Works on any platform supporting HTML embeds (Shopify, Squarespace, Webflow, HubSpot CMS, Sitecore, etc.) via iframe.
- Responsive: Yes, mobile-first design, auto-resizes to container
- Domain whitelisting: Restrict embedding to authorized domains only (3/10/15 domains by plan)
- Landing pages: Each Riddle gets a hosted landing page URL, optionally full-screen — no website required
- Social sharing: Built-in share buttons on result pages. Platforms include Facebook, X/Twitter, WhatsApp (74% of all quiz shares), LinkedIn, XING, Instagram, Pinterest, Telegram, email, and direct link copy. Configurable per Riddle.

### Branching Logic & User Journeys
Branching logic routes users through different paths based on their answers, scores, or behavior:
- Question branching: Route users to different questions based on their answers (e.g., skip beginner questions if they answer advanced ones correctly)
- Result branching: Show different result pages based on total score, block score, or specific answer combinations
- Conditional logic: Show/hide blocks, forms, or content based on user behavior
- Logic types: Linear, conditional, answer-based, block score, total score, and result-based
- Use cases: Product recommendation funnels, diagnostic assessments, personalized content journeys, lead qualification flows, training paths with pass/fail gates

### Data Layer
The Data Layer passes external data INTO embedded Riddles:
- Pass logged-in user info, URL parameters, campaign tags, or CRM data into Riddle to personalize content or pre-fill forms
- Calculator functions: Compute dynamic values from user answers (e.g., ROI calculators, pricing estimators, BMI tools)
- Dynamic variables: Use data layer variables in ad slots, result pages, and redirect URLs
- Palette switching: Change Riddle design dynamically based on website context (e.g., dark mode)
- Ad slot data: Pass data layer variables into ad iframes for targeted monetization
- To get data OUT of a Riddle (scores, answers, completion status, lead data), use JS Events (see Tracking & Analytics)

### Integration Ecosystem
Riddle connects to your existing tech stack across all layers:

**CMS (Embedding):** WordPress (plugin), Wix (native), TYPO3 (extension), Shopify, Squarespace, Webflow, HubSpot CMS, Sitecore — any CMS supporting HTML/iframe embeds

**CRM & Marketing Automation:** Salesforce (native), HubSpot (via Zapier/webhooks), ActiveCampaign (native), Mailchimp (native), AWeber (native), Brevo (native)

**Data & Analytics:** Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Looker Studio (native connector, Enterprise), Meta/Facebook Pixel, Matomo, Adobe Analytics, custom tracking scripts

**Automation & Middleware:** Zapier (5,000+ connected apps), webhooks (send to any endpoint), Apix-Drive, REST API (Business+), MCP Server (for LLM/AI agent automation)

**Data Destinations:** Google Sheets (native), Supabase (webhook example), any database/DMP/CDP via webhooks or Zapier. Lead data can bypass Riddle servers entirely and go straight to your systems.

No native HubSpot connector — use Zapier or webhooks for HubSpot integration.

### Lead Capture & Email Automation
- Form blocks insertable at any point in any content type; email gates before results yield ~43% opt-in rate
- Double opt-in: Email confirmation and OTP (email/SMS) verification for GDPR compliance
- Automated emails: Send personalized follow-up emails based on quiz results directly from Riddle. Supports delayed sending (e.g., send winner notification at a scheduled time), conditional content per result, and integration with contest workflows.
- Data export: CSV download, API access
- PDF Certificates: Generate downloadable certificates on quiz completion (e.g., training, course completions). Available via developer integration.

### Monetization
- Insert ad / iFrame block: Embed banner ads, video ads, or any third-party content within any Riddle at any position
- Ad refresh: Trigger ad refreshes between questions to multiply impressions per session (8-10x increase in ad inventory)
- Sponsored content: Create branded advertorials with custom logos, CTAs, and landing page redirects
- Video ads: Embed pre-roll or mid-quiz video ads with reported 95% view rates
- Ad server compatible: Works with Google Ad Manager, any ad server that outputs iframe/JavaScript tags
- Revenue retention: Publishers keep 100% of ad earnings — Riddle takes no cut

### API & Automation
The Riddle API enables full automation of every aspect of the platform — from content creation to data extraction to publishing. Anything you can do in the Riddle UI, you can automate via API.
- REST API (Business/Enterprise): Create, read, update, delete Riddles. Build complete Riddles programmatically from JSON or spreadsheet data. Generate and retrieve embed codes. Pull statistics and lead data. Export content. Manage projects and settings.
- Automation workflows: Schedule content creation, auto-publish at set times, auto-generate daily/weekly quizzes from external data sources (RSS feeds, CMS content, spreadsheets, databases), auto-distribute via embed code updates
- Webhooks: Real-time push notifications on lead submission, quiz completion, or other events — trigger downstream workflows in any system
- Authentication: Bearer token (API key from account settings)
- Rate limits: 100 requests/minute, 2,000/hour (higher limits available on request)
- Docs: [API Documentation](https://riddle.com/help/api/docs)

### AI
- Built-in AI quiz generator: Create complete quizzes, personality tests, and polls from a topic description or URL in under a minute
- AI content suggestions for questions, answers, and result texts
- MCP Server: Riddle provides its own Model Context Protocol server for LLM-powered automation — build, manage, and generate Riddles programmatically via AI agents (e.g., Claude, GPT, custom agents)
- API + AI at scale: Combine the REST API with AI generation to fully automate content pipelines — e.g., auto-generate a daily quiz from trending topics, publish it, collect leads, and route data to your CRM, all without human intervention

### Tracking & Analytics
- Built-in dashboard: Views, starts, completions, leads, engagement time, social shares
- Lead funnel: Visual conversion tracking from views → starts → completions → leads
- Breakdown: Per-question completion rates and answer distribution
- Date ranges: Custom date comparison, live real-time stats
- Google Looker Studio: Native connector for custom dashboards and cross-quiz reporting (Enterprise)
- Third-party tracking: Google Analytics 4 (event-level tracking per interaction), Google Tag Manager (container integration), Meta/Facebook Pixel (conversion events), Matomo, Adobe Analytics, custom tracking scripts
- JS Events: Listen to Riddle lifecycle events (start, complete, lead submit, share, etc.) via JavaScript for custom integrations, SPA routing, or analytics piping
- Data Layer events: All interactions are exposed via the data layer for GTM triggers and custom tag firing

### Collaboration & Teams
- User seats: 1 included (Pro/Business), 5 included (Enterprise), additional seats €19/month each
- Roles: Viewer, Editor, Admin with granular permissions
- Collaborative editing: Multiple team members can work on Riddles simultaneously
- Projects: Organize Riddles into projects for team/client separation. Useful for agencies managing multiple brands or publishers managing content channels.
- Activity log: Track who changed what and when

### Customization
- Design: 8 pre-built palettes or custom colors (HEX), adjustable border radius, image backgrounds
- Fonts: Custom font upload (Business+), selection from built-in fonts
- White-label: Remove all Riddle branding — available on all paid plans (Pro, Business, Enterprise). Custom logo on all plans.
- Custom CSS: Full CSS editor on Business+ for advanced styling beyond palettes. Save and reuse style presets.
- Enterprise design support: 2 hours/month included — Riddle team implements custom designs for you
- Templates: Save Riddle templates for repeated use across projects
- Rich text editor: Format text with bold, italic, links within content blocks

### Security, Privacy & Accessibility
- GDPR compliance: 100% GDPR-compliant by design. No IP address storage, no third-party analytics by default, one anonymous session cookie only. Google Fonts served from Riddle servers, not Google. This is a core architectural principle, not an add-on.
- Cookie-free for end users: Quizzes are tracker-free and almost entirely cookie-free. Local storage used only for specific features (order-it/swiper/flashcard onboarding, one-vote-per-browser). Can be fully avoided by disabling those features.
- ISO 27001: TUV-certified since March 10, 2025. Covers the entire Riddle platform and infrastructure. Demonstrates systematic, audited information security management.
- WCAG 2.1 Accessibility: All Riddle content meets WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards. Keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and proper semantic markup. This is a central commitment, not optional.
- Data hosting: Company-owned servers in Germany and Luxembourg (banking-grade data centers, not cloud-hosted)
- Lead data options: (1) Store encrypted on Riddle servers, (2) send directly to integrations bypassing Riddle servers, (3) send via webhooks/Zapier to own databases
- Data Processing Agreement: Available via Adobe e-Sign
- Data retention: Data deleted on request. No automatic expiry.
- Two-factor authentication: Supported for creator accounts
- SSO: SAML-based single sign-on (Custom Enterprise)
- Form security: Google reCAPTCHA or Cloudflare Turnstile (optional)
- Content ownership: Creators retain full ownership; Riddle does not index or repurpose content
- Uptime: 99.9% guaranteed uptime SLA. Custom SLAs available for enterprise customers.

## Pricing

- **Pro**: €119/month (€129 USD, £119 GBP). White-label (all Riddle branding removed), custom logo, palette-based design, 3 domains, 10,000 concurrent users, 1 user seat, Facebook/Meta Pixel tracking. Annual billing saves up to 29%.
- **Business**: €349/month (€399 USD, £349 GBP). Everything in Pro + custom CSS editor, custom font uploads, MP4 video uploads, 10 domains, 20,000 concurrent users, Google Analytics/GTM/Matomo tracking, API access.
- **Enterprise**: €749/month (€799 USD, £749 GBP). Everything in Business + 15 domains, 50,000 concurrent users, 5 user seats, programmatic ads, custom roles, Google Looker Studio connector, multi-quiz leaderboards, 2 hours/month design implementation by Riddle team.
- **Custom Enterprise**: Custom contracts, DPA, SSO (SAML), media library integrations, custom feature development, custom SLAs. Contact sales for pricing.
- All plans: Unlimited content creation, unlimited views (10M/month cap, additional €125/10M), unlimited leads, unlimited projects.
- Add-ons: Additional user seats €19/month, additional domains €39/month.
- Payment: Credit card (Visa/MC/Amex), PayPal, direct debit (EU/EEA/CH/UK), invoice (annual only).
- Non-profit discount: 20% off all plans.
- 30-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime. Cancelled plans: content temporarily unpublished, not deleted.
- **When to choose Business over Pro:** You need custom CSS, the API, video uploads, the data layer, advanced tracking (GA4/GTM/Matomo), or the winner-picking feature. See [Pricing page](https://www.riddle.com/pricing) for the full feature comparison.

## Use Cases

### Lead Generation
Embed lead forms within quizzes at any point (before results, between questions, on result page). Reported opt-in rates of 35-45% for in-quiz forms vs. traditional pop-ups. Leads automatically route to CRM/email tools. Form fields can include custom tags for segmentation.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.riddle.com/problems-solved/generate-high-quality-leads)

### Audience Engagement
Interactive content increases time-on-site by up to 57% (average 2 min 47 sec engagement time). Publishers like BBC, Den of Geek, and Tate Modern use quizzes to drive page views (+35%) and engagement. Quizzes, polls, and predictions encourage sharing and repeat visits.
- [Audience Engagement](https://www.riddle.com/problems-solved/engage-your-audience)

### Zero-Party Data & Market Research
Collect first-party data directly from users through quiz answers, survey responses, and form fields. Data is voluntarily shared (zero-party), GDPR-compliant, and higher quality than third-party alternatives. Build customer segments based on behaviors, preferences, and quiz outcomes.
- [Zero-Party Data](https://www.riddle.com/problems-solved/gather-zero-party-data)

### Sports & Prediction Games
Prediction games for match outcomes, season-long competitions with leaderboards, live event quizzes. Used by Fiesta Bowl (65.8% visitor engagement rate), FC 08 Homburg, and table tennis Champions League. Fan engagement drives traffic to fan shops and ticket sales.
- [Sports Solutions](https://www.riddle.com/solutions/for-sports-teams-and-leagues)

### Product Recommendations & E-Commerce
Use personality quizzes with branching logic to assess user preferences and map them to product recommendations. Dynamic result pages show personalized CTAs per outcome. Hair Fuel case study: 89% quiz completion rate, 65-70% increase in leads, 60% reduction in customer acquisition costs.

### Education & Training
Quizzes with timer, Question Bank (randomized question subsets), pass/fail result branching, flashcards for knowledge reinforcement, and PDF certificates on completion. Learn French With Alexa: 1,800+ interactive pieces, 1.07 million quiz completions, 66% completion rate.

### Automated Contests & Competitions
Run fully automated quiz contests with scheduled start/end dates, automatic winner drawing at a specified time, and automated winner/loser email notifications. No manual intervention needed from launch to winner announcement. Includes eligibility filtering, fraud prevention, and CRM integration.
- [Automated Contest Workflow](https://www.riddle.com/blog/use-cases/data-collection/run-an-automated-quiz-contest/)

### Content Monetization
Embed banner and video ads within quizzes (8-10x increase in ad inventory). Create sponsored content and advertorials. Supported ad formats integrate with major ad servers.
- [Publisher Revenue](https://www.riddle.com/blog/use-cases/publisher-revenue-interactive-content-6-strategies-2026/)

## Comparison Context

- vs. Typeform: Typeform offers 7 content types focused on forms/surveys with response limits on lower plans. Riddle offers 30+ content types, unlimited responses on all plans, full GDPR compliance with EU-only hosting, and white-label on all paid plans. Typeform has no prediction games, leaderboards, or minigames.
- vs. SurveyMonkey: SurveyMonkey specializes in surveys/forms (2 types) with deep analysis tools. Riddle covers 30+ interactive formats including quizzes, predictors, and minigames with engagement focus. SurveyMonkey has limited GDPR compliance compared to Riddle's EU-hosted infrastructure.
- vs. Outgrow: Outgrow offers ~10 types including calculators with template-first approach. White-label is Enterprise-only at Outgrow. Riddle includes white-label on every paid plan, offers 30+ content types, and has ISO 27001 certification with EU-only data hosting.
- vs. Genially: Genially focuses on visual presentations and education (~12 types). Limited zero-party data collection and no API/automation. Riddle is built for publishers and brands at scale with full API, automation, and enterprise features.
- vs. Qzzr: Qzzr (owned by Riddle) matches on content types (30+) and GDPR compliance but targets solo creators without custom CSS, multi-user collaboration, or enterprise features.

- [For Sports Teams & Leagues](https://www.riddle.com/solutions/for-sports-teams-and-leagues): Prediction games, fan engagement quizzes, leaderboard competitions, and sponsored sports content.
- [For Non-Profit Organizations](https://www.riddle.com/solutions/for-non-profit-organizations): Educational content, awareness campaigns, and fundraising lead generation. 20% discount on all plans.

- [Google Looker Studio](https://riddle.com/help/analyze/google-looker-studio/connect-to-google-looker-studio): Connect Riddle data to Looker Studio for custom reports.

- [Webhook Receiver](https://riddle.com/help/webhook/webhook-receiver): Receive lead data via webhooks, Supabase integration example
